Photo 0 also shows the headlamp mounting brackets/black plastic tabs attached to the assemblies.
Photo 1 shows a front grille with a central badge/emblem; the grille has vertical slats and chrome surround around the badge.
Photo 1 does not show any tail light (rear lamp).

identity.kind: Toyota Prado front grille and front headlight assemblies (pair)

claims.claim: Prado Jeep front grill and tailight in working condition available in GRA Ikeja.
claims.evidence: Photos show a front grille (photo 1) and front headlamp assemblies (photo 0), but no tail light/rear lamp is shown, and 'working condition' cannot be verified from photos.
Photo 1 clearly shows a front grille with a central badge.
No tail light/rear lamp appears in either photo; only front headlamps (photo 0) and a front grille (photo 1) are visible.

risks.risk: Tail light mismatch: seller may be offering front lights instead of rear tail lights (or incomplete set).
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the exact tail light(s) (rear lamps) with the same grille/headlamp items, plus a close-up of the tail light lens and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: Price as front grille + front headlamp assemblies only (and treat tail lights as not included).

risks.risk: Wrong side/fitment or variant (Prado year/trim differences) causing mounting/connector mismatch.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the back of each headlamp/tail lamp showing part numbers/connector type, and a photo of the grille mounting tabs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used parts with possible fitment issues (assume buyer may need extra brackets/repairs).

risks.risk: Not actually working (bulbs/ballasts/LEDs may be dead, foggy lens, or internal damage).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video powering the headlamps (and tail lamps if included) showing both low/high (or DRL/indicator) and no flicker.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working (or unknown function) until tested.

risks.risk: Cracks, water ingress, or lens clouding not obvious in these angles.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of lens surfaces (front and edges) and any condensation inside the lamp housing.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential cosmetic/condition issues.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the tail light(s) (rear lamps) if they are truly included—front and back, showing mounting points.
Send close-ups of any part numbers/labels on the headlamp/tail lamp housings and the grille mounting tabs.
Send a short video showing the lights powered on (headlamps and tail lamps if included).
Send close-up photos of lens condition (edges and inside for moisture/condensation).
response.reason: The photos show a front grille and front headlamp assemblies, but the seller claims tail lights and 'working condition'—neither is verifiable from the images. Proof is needed to confirm the correct items and whether they work.
